comment: The weather of the first dungeon: dust motes that hang in the air, and slow drips from the ceiling (D-187, D-202). The motes start across the view and fall slowly, and each drip falls fast. The scene light falls on both, so a mote lights up inside a pool of torchlight (D-183). The view is 640 by 360 art pixels, and each x and y comes from its north-west corner (D-842). PR-17 gives the first places their own weather (D-520).
